name: @base-ui/source
description: base-services shared UI infrastructure — a premium, fully-themeable, RTL/Arabic-ready React + Tailwind design system, plus a paper/block document editor and generic auth/footer pages. Consumed AS SOURCE via the `@base-ui` Vite/tsconfig alias (not installed as an npm package). React, react-dom, react-router-dom, lucide-react, clsx, tailwind-merge and class-variance-authority are PEERS supplied by each consuming app. Nothing is hard-coded: every colour is a token resolved to a CSS variable emitted from theme.config.ts, every string comes through an i18n seam, and every data/callback is a prop.
